description: A department head must decide how to respond to Lena's recent meeting-attendance problems and stakeholder concerns, choosing between a formal performance process and a structured support response while determining the practical terms of Lena's work.

shared_context.S1: Lena has missed three cross-team meetings in the past month, and two stakeholders have complained that her absences made coordination harder.
shared_context.S2: Maya is responsible for deciding the formal response and any changes to Lena's responsibilities.
shared_context.S3: Lena's current role includes attending cross-team meetings and presenting selected project updates to clients.
shared_context.S4: As part of the department's normal performance-review process, Maya holds a check-in with the involved teammate, project colleague, and HR partner before finalizing a response.

PF1.text: Rafael works closely with Lena and knows she has been taking her parent to recurring morning medical appointments. Lena told him she can reliably attend meetings scheduled after 10:30 a.m., but she has not raised this with Maya because she expected the appointment schedule to stabilize.

PF2.text: Tessa observed Lena successfully lead two client demonstrations this month after completing the required presentation practice; those demonstrations were internal project sessions and were not included in Maya's performance packet.

PF3.text: Imani confirmed this morning that HR policy requires a documented 30-day coaching and support plan, rather than an immediate formal performance-improvement plan, when an attendance problem is connected to a disclosed caregiving constraint. The required plan must include issuing written expectations for attendance and communication. The case file has not yet been updated with that confirmation.

acceptance_conditions: A documented coaching and support response must be selected instead of an immediate formal performance-improvement plan.
Recurring cross-team meetings must be scheduled to start at 10:30 a.m.
Lena must retain assignment of the client presentation role.
The support response must last exactly 30 days.
Written expectations for attendance and communication must be issued as part of the response.

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed
provenance_checks.P3: 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The caregiving schedule changes the meeting start time from an ordinary earlier schedule to exactly 10:30 a.m.
Lena's two successful client demonstrations change the client presentation assignment from removing her from that role to retaining Lena as the presenter.

The confirmed HR rule changes the response to a documented 30-day coaching and support plan and specifically changes written_expectations_issued from false to true because written attendance and communication expectations must be issued.
